findings.problem: The voice says what part C wants (the size of the acceleration at A), but the board only writes d²x/dt², so the target is never written in words and letters.
findings.fix: On "wants the size of the acceleration at A", write a short line such as `Want: |d²x/dt²| at A = ?` before writing the d²x/dt² line.

findings.problem: The voice says to put negative one in place of sine πt/3, but the (−1) just appears in the new line. A student does not see that it comes from the line just above.
findings.fix: Give the (−1) token `from` the −1 in `sin(πt/3) = −1` on line 15, and move it down into place on "in place of".
